title: A 24 point icon shows at 32 and 48 beside the artboard too
goal: The preview strip beside an icon frame only shows sizes at or below the frame's own, so a 24 point icon shows at 16 and 24 and never at 48, which the icon success list and the drawing walkthrough both promise. Designers check a 24 icon at 32 and 48 as well, on a dark chip for one of them, as the mock draws.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/icon-draw-wt.html #igSizes step 11 (16, 24, 32, 48 with 32 on a dark chip). Answered card see-an-icon-at-the-size-it-will-really-be-used ('strip') promised 16 to 64. Code: Sources/PhotonzCore/IconPreviews.swift sides(forFrameSide:) ~51-56 deliberately keeps only sizes at or below the frame ('Nothing bigger'), test pins it at Tests/PhotonzCoreTests/IconPreviewTests.swift:44 (expects [16, 24]). Chips all use .fill(.quaternary) in Sources/Photonz/IconPreviewsStrip.swift chip(). The mock is the floor: change the rule, update the test first.
acceptance: A new 24 point icon frame at Next defaults shows previews at 16, 24, 32 and 48, updating as you draw
One chip is dark as in icon-draw-wt.html step 11, so a light glyph can be checked
16 and 32 point frames show the sizes the mock implies for them, and the rule is written in the audit
Audit written under queue/audits/ with the strip beside the mock; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not
